avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Induces CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, reducing citalopram levels and efficacy; increases serotonin syndrome risk
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue St. John's Wort at least 2 weeks before starting citalopram or avoid concurrent use

avoid_supplements.name: Serotonergic supplements (5-HTP, L-tryptophan)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive serotonergic effects increase risk of serotonin syndrome
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient on serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, confusion, tremor, hyperthermia)

avoid_supplements.name: MAO inhibitor-containing supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Severe risk of serotonin syndrome and hypertensive crisis
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; maintain 14-day washout period between MAOIs and citalopram initiation

caution_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild antiplatelet effects; citalopram may increase bleeding risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for unusual bruising or bleeding; ensure adequate monitoring if concurrent use necessary

caution_supplements.name: Garlic supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential antiplatelet activity with additive bleeding risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor bleeding risk; counsel on signs of abnormal bleeding

avoid_foods.name: Tyramine-rich foods (with MAOIs only - not applicable to citalopram monotherapy)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Hypertensive crisis risk if citalopram combined with MAOIs
avoid_foods.action: Only relevant if citalopram used with MAOI; avoid aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented products in that scenario

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: CNS depression; may increase sedation, dizziness, and impair cognitive function
caution_foods.action: Counsel patient to limit alcohol consumption; advise avoiding or minimizing use, especially early in treatment

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may modestly increase citalopram plasma concentrations
caution_foods.action: Consider limiting grapefruit consumption; monitor for excessive side effects if intake is significant

monitoring_notes: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms when initiating or increasing citalopram dose, especially with concurrent serotonergic agents. Assess QT interval at baseline and with higher doses (≥40 mg/day), as citalopram carries dose-dependent QT prolongation risk.
